records.text: Bob Bryar wrote that the Kardashians were the slimiest pile of garbage on the planet, that they had blood on their hands, and that he knew everything
records.speaker: Bob Bryar

appearances.snippet: We just separated in September because the Kardashians are the slimiest pile of garbage on the planet. ... They actually have blood on their hands, and I know everything.

verification.notes: Verified only as attribution to the quoted X post: Bob Bryar used these words about the Kardashians and asserted that they had blood on their hands and that he knew everything. No evidence in the post substantiates the blood-on-their-hands accusation, and this verification does not treat that accusation as proven.

records.text: Bob Bryar posted that Lou Taylor had been his business manager for 18 years and that they separated in September
records.speaker: Bob Bryar

appearances.snippet: Don't forget that Lou Taylor was my business manager for 18 years. ... We just separated in September because the Kardashians are the slimiest pile of garbage on the planet.

verification.notes: Verified as a quoted-post attribution. The surviving direct X URL and an archived reproduction preserve Bob Bryar statement that Lou Taylor had been his business manager for 18 years and that they separated in September. The X snowflake identifies the post date as November 5, 2024, correcting the episode and legacy note that called it an October post. This verifies what Bryar posted, not the underlying management records.
